name: example
game: Placeholder profile (example data, not a game)
detection: Place the companions beside the XP3 archives. crysirror-launch takes the profile as its first Nana candidate and looks for the startup key under the selected executable's stem.

derivation.startup_line_source: example.key: a UTF-16LE record whose first line the native bootstrap passes to Array.load
derivation.control_block: SHAKE256 over the UTF-16LE startup line, truncated to CONTROL_BLOCK_SIZE (4096)
derivation.filter_parameters: SipHash-2-4 keyed by control[0:16] over the UTF-16LE startup line

notes: Example data only: the startup line is a fixed placeholder string and the content parameters are not a real title's.
The bundle still verifies: --check re-derives the control table, mask, offset and name state from example.key.
Installing this into a real game directory does not unlock that game; generate a bundle from your own installation instead.
